meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 智能体创建和管理身份：先建蓝图（Blueprint），再建主服务主体（BlueprintPrincipal），最后为每个智能体实例建独立身份，并按实例授予权限、配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换。
howto.when: 当你提到「Agent Identity Blueprint」「agent OAuth」「fmi_path 令牌交换」等关键词，或要求为 AI 智能体配置独立身份和 OAuth 2.0 权限时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建 Agent Identity Blueprint
say.note: 会调用 Graph API 创建蓝图并返回 appId。

say.text: 给这个 Agent Identity 授予 User.Read.All 应用权限
配置 fmi_path 令牌交换，支持 OBO
say.note: 配置两步令牌交换，实现代用户访问。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can guide you through Microsoft Graph to create and manage identities for AI agents: a Blueprint, a BlueprintPrincipal, and per-instance Agent Identities, plus OAuth 2.0 token exchange and per-identity permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Agent Identity Blueprint, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, or ask to set up independent identities and OAuth 2.0 permissions for AI agents.

say_en.note: Calls Graph API and returns the appId.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All to this Agent Identity.
Set up fmi_path exchange for OBO.
